description: This PHP source file contains functions for generating and managing test specifications and test coverage views within the TestLink testing management system. It includes functions for building hierarchical test suite structures, filtering test cases, handling linked test case versions, and managing custom fields, primarily used for rendering test plan and test project views.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case data and operations, including retrieving test case versions and filtering.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class managing platform data, used for retrieving platform information linked to test plans or projects.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data, used for retrieving linked test case versions and related information.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data, used for retrieving project-specific information and keywords.

methods.name: gen_spec_view
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical view of test specifications for a given node, filtering and pruning empty branches.

methods.name: gen_coverage_view
methods.description: Generates a coverage view of test cases and test suites, filtering and pruning as needed.

methods.name: getFilteredLinkedVersions
methods.description: Retrieves linked test case versions filtered by keyword, platform, and other criteria.

methods.name: getFilteredSpecView
methods.description: Filters and retrieves a test specification view based on various filters and options.

methods.name: getFilteredSpecViewFlat
methods.description: Retrieves a flat list of test cases and test suites with filtering applied.

methods.name: getTestSpecFromNode
methods.description: Retrieves a subtree of test cases starting from a specific node, applying filters.

methods.name: removeEmptyTestSuites
methods.description: Removes test suites with no test cases or sub-suites from the view.

methods.name: removeEmptyBranches
methods.description: Prunes branches of test suites that have no test cases.

methods.name: addCustomFieldsToView
methods.description: Adds custom field information to test suite and test case views.

methods.name: buildSkeleton
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical skeleton structure of test suites and test cases.

methods.name: buildSkeletonFlat
methods.description: Builds a flat list structure of test suites and test cases.
